facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports Gabon is developing an interoperability platform meant to let government information systems securely exchange data, reviewed at the sixth e-Gabon-SIS and Gabon Digital steering committee; no live connections or figures are given.

systems.owner: ANINF (National Agency for Digital Infrastructure and Frequencies) implementing, under the Ministry of Digital Economy

note: States an ordinance (published 2025-09-07) making interconnection of administrations mandatory, a law with no platform named, so no fact; the ANPI online incorporation site is a citizen e-service.

facts.fact: The World Bank's Digital Gabon ISR (Dec 2024) sets a closing-2026 target of 5 government entities exchanging data on the government interoperability platform, with the actual at baseline 0, and the loan only 1.92% disbursed.

note: The state interoperability platform is named only as one of four workstreams followed by the 8 September steering committee, with no procurement, build or pilot stated.
Interoperability named as a programme theme only; no platform stated as built or live.
Only planned data exchanges of the future SIGRH with payroll, budget and national identification; no platform stated.
A draft interoperability framework for the health information system, with no platform running.

facts.fact: The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) finances the development and implementation of an Interoperability Platform (IoP) for secure data exchange within government.

note: DPI Map lines are database claims; each is held, contradicted, or outside the study's aspects.
